counterfactual_missing_items: No AFB-positive histiocytes in alternative diagnoses
No clinical features of systemic lupus or sarcoidosis
Multibacillary subtype not captured by R1 alone
decisive_items: Earlobe tissue fluid showed acid-fast bacilli (Bacterial Index 4.8)
Nodular infiltrates of foamy histiocytes in dermis arranged in storiform pattern
response.rationale: C1 directly incorporates the decisive raw evidence of abundant AFB and high bacterial index, which are pathognomonic for multibacillary leprosy)Skip; R1 only has mild hypoaesthesia as raw support but its generator assessments acknowledge AFB, while C1 properly adds the subtype. R4 and R5 lack any raw support for the AFB findings and are contradicted by the infectious histopathology.

rejected.why: Sarcoidosis is unsupported because abundant acid-fast bacilli within histiocytes directly contradict a non-infectious granulomatous disease; storiform pattern is nonspecific.
Autoantibodies are present but not diagnostic alone; AFB and hypoaesthesia strongly favor leprosy, and the histopathology is not consistent with lupus.
